findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 3, Harm 4 (floor: migration)
Raise: Not done
Case: normal use - An old review that floored a finding about an unchanged migration can still block after upgrade. The v1.2.49 review prompt (`src/forge/templates/review.md:460`) instructed reviewers to score such findings Harm 4, and its `score.normalise` (`src/forge/score.py:48`) removed any floor marker when Harm was already 4. This check misses that saved finding, so `close.py:322` reuses it without a recheck. The new upgrade test supplies Harm 1 to the old reviewer and covers only the marker-present case. Even when the marker is present, an item already stopped by that finding is refused at `close.py:180` before the new check runs. The history repair also misses reviews made before a fix was promoted: `time_records.py:219` reads the task's state history, while `story.py:1154` transfers only the latest fix review. Earlier P1 findings can therefore remain P0 in the pull request history.
